evidence.observation: O2 at 6.5 ppm at start of growth, consistent with the ramp baseline of ~4-8 ppm
O2 rose steadily 12.3→16.2→19.5→25.7 ppm over 2640-3000 s, about 4x baseline and still rising
Ar flow holds at ~100 sccm setpoint, so the rise is not from reduced purge flow
T steady at 750 °C, heater ~46%, thermal control normal
Pressure gauge not installed; cannot tell a seal leak from an exhaust restriction

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure, or a leak check such as a brief Ar flow step or a leak test on the seals, to tell an air-ingress seal leak from an exhaust blockage or back-diffusion; no normal-run ref values given for O2 during growth.
